description: The chart is a two-layered donut chart representing the distribution of responses to a survey on defending against social engineering attacks in the age of language models (LLMs). The outer layer, labeled 'Ambiguity 1 (Outer)', shows three categories: 'Deceived' in red with 67.6%, 'Partially' in yellow with 57.9%, and 'Not Deceived' in green with 10.5%. The inner layer, labeled 'Ambiguity 2 (Inner)', also has three categories: 'Deceived' in red with 23.5%, 'Partially' in yellow with 8.8%, and 'Not Deceived' in green with 10.5%. The chart includes a legend on the right side, with color-coded labels for each category. The percentages are displayed within the corresponding slices of the chart. The chart does not include any additional visual emphasis such as exploded or offset slices, nor does it have percentage labels inside the slices. The segments are ordered by size, with the 'Deceived' category being the largest in both layers.
